normalized.description: We will purchase a ground station for two-way radiolink communications for CubeSat-type nanosatellites. The ground station must have RXTX capabilities in the VHF and UHF radio bands used by the CubeSats. The ground station must fit the Finnish climate, and it must be equipped with an appropriate controller computer, antenna, and cable configuration. The antennas must have high gain, so the antennas need to be automatically/programmatically steerable. We will weight the GnuRadio compatibility, maintainability, extensibility, and open-source firmware/software in the quality criteria of the ground station.
